superseded.note: r5: admitted under the round-3 rules, but reply charges ended only on collection (F4 ledger over-counted value-list replies) and the perf page closed with a re-render plus one click to release React-held updates; superseded by r6 (replies settled on adoption, idle close).
r4: admitted under the round-2 evaluator (post-close floor, fixed 2 MiB tolerance, timer-released replies); it has no warmed-host baseline and does not validate under the round-3 rules.
r3: not admitted (no main-owned ledger; main peak pending). It predates the round-2 evidence rules and the ledger, so it does not validate under the current evaluator.
r2 was admitted by the earlier summary-trusting evaluator; it does not validate under the raw-derived evaluator (no content fixture identity, no live heap samples, main-memory peak pending).
r1: input acknowledgment miss (header sort 11,897-13,316 ms).

viewerEvidence.note: S10.2 viewer receipt, desktop D admitted. Main peak from the main-thread ledger (lifetime charges; reply charges settled when the payload is adopted); every forced-GC live sample above an independently warmed host is covered, allowance = measured probe noise. The page stays idle after close. Mobile rows not-run (no physical iPad, user decision). Recorded on a shared machine; re-run the release command on a quiet machine.
